tickets.title: Fork: direct-exec agent.start enters the managed launch lifecycle (launch_pending → interactive_ready)
tickets.what: Live check after herdr-fork/04 (2026-11-25): claude, agy and pi started through direct-exec all lost their first prompt. `start_agent_direct_exec` (src/app/agents.rs ~530-560) pins the declared kind and sets the name but never calls `TerminalState::begin_managed_agent`, so `launch_pending` is never true, `interactive_ready` never becomes true, and `agent.prompt` accepts input while the TUI is still starting (text lands in the editor, the delayed Enter is lost; agy printed it above its banner). The shell path (agents.rs:236-280) uses begin_managed_agent with AGENT_START_SETTLE_DELAY and the request timeout. Make direct-exec starts with a name use the same managed lifecycle (Pending until detection shows the declared kind settled, then Active), so `agent.get` reports launch_pending/interactive_ready and `agent.prompt` refuses with agent_not_ready while pending. Accept `timeout_ms` on direct-exec starts with the shell-path bounds. A managed timeout or kind mismatch must not kill or close the direct-exec process (it only clears pending/name as the shell path does); process exit keeps today's on_exit behaviour. Codex prompt-ready (`observe_codex_prompt_ready`) must work for direct-exec too. Work in ~/projects/herdr-hud on a branch from `hud` (e.g. hud-05), merge into `hud`; never push; do not install or touch ~/.local/bin/herdr or the running server.

tickets.title: Fork: guarded typing (agent.prompt that never touches a draft)
tickets.what: D-2026-11-26-01 step 2c, moved into the first install. A guarded form of `agent.prompt` (flag or method): it types and submits only when the agent is idle and interactive_ready, the prompt line is empty, the pane is not scrolled back, and no key arrived from a client in the last few seconds (configurable, default 3 s); otherwise it refuses with a machine-readable reason (`draft_present`, `scrolled_back`, `recent_input`, `not_ready`). Prompt-line emptiness is per agent kind (claude, codex, agy, pi); where herdr cannot tell, it refuses with `prompt_unknown` rather than guessing. The guard's state is in memory only, never recorded or exported. Capability flag in ping. Branch hud-11 from `hud`, merge; never push; never install or touch the running server.

acceptance.text: Tests per kind: empty idle prompt submits; a typed draft, scroll-back or a key 1 s ago refuses with its reason and writes nothing

tickets.title: Fork: the sidebar state slot draws a pane's icon token in the state colour
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-26: worker rows in herdr's left sidebar should show an icon for the worker's kind (HUD role) instead of the state dot. When a pane's metadata tokens contain `hud_icon` (reported by HUD via `pane.report_metadata`, herdr-fork/19), the agent row's `state_icon` token draws that glyph (first grapheme, width 1; fall back to the dot if wider or empty) with exactly the style the dot would have for the current state (colours, blink/attention). Panes without the token are unchanged. Document in HUD-FORK.md. Fork worktree on its own branch from `hud`; do not merge; never push or install.

acceptance.text: Tests: a pane with hud_icon draws the glyph in each state's style; a wide or empty glyph falls back to the dot; panes without the token unchanged; render width unchanged
Live try: with herdr-fork/19 landed and this installed, workers show their role icon coloured by state in the sidebar

tickets.title: Fork: agy stays working across in-turn background work
tickets.live_try: after install, a live agy turn runs `sleep 6` in the background: herdr pane get keeps agent_status working through the wait and emits one change to idle/done within ~1.5 s after the turn ends
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-26: herdr has long shown Antigravity (agy) as idle/done while agy runs background work, and HUD worked around it from outside (D-2026-11-17-05, D-2026-11-18-04, D-2026-11-19-01). Design from oracle job jb786b61850a1b98a (read its full report: section Q3 option 5 and Slice 1, file:line in the fork @017b2700). Build in the fork (~/projects/herdr-hud, branch `hud`; own worktree and branch from `hud`; do not merge, push or install): (1) src/detect/manifests/antigravity.toml: widen `esc_cancel_footer_working` to bottom_non_empty_lines 10 and `spinner_working` to 24 (task panel and tall prompts push the markers out today); blocked rules still win. (2) A lazy turn-scoped descendant hold for Agent::Antigravity only: stamp turn_start_tick on the transition into Working (or an accepted prompt / user input while idle); only when PendingIdleConfirmation is about to confirm Working -> Idle (visible_idle false), walk /proc children of the verified agy root (pid + start token; direct-exec child_pid/child_start_time or AgentJobTracker's process on shell panes) with the existing budget (512 pids, 25 ms); hold Working with a 1 s recheck while any non-zombie descendant started at or after the turn start lives; release on exit, agent exit, reset, or new user input on that pane (owner-chosen default: a human's new prompt releases a lingering daemon hold). Pre-turn descendants do not count but are walked through; turn-1 launch-window non-shell MCP helpers and npm exec / pnpm dlx / npx / uvx bootstrap chains (port of MyHUD src/mcp/cli-judge.ts bootstrap) are exempt while turn children under them count. Zero /proc walks while the screen already says Working, Blocked or confirmed Idle. (3) Capability `agy_background_work: true` on ping, schema artifact regenerated. (4) Hardening from the same report: `update.manifest_check` defaults to false so remote manifests never override the bundled antigravity.toml; `inspect_agy_prompt` (src/app/prompt_guard.rs) refuses Empty when the footer below the prompt shows `N task(s)`. (5) HUD-FORK.md documents all of it with the Apache-2.0 4(b) notices. Tests per the report's Slice 1 list; full fork test pass single-threaded (split around the known SIGPIPE case client_shell_attach_seeds_workspace), api_ping, live_handoff, release build.

acceptance.text: antigravity.toml windows widened; blocked dialogs still win (screen fixture tests: task panel, tall prompt)

An in-turn agy descendant holds Working with 1 s rechecks and releases to idle/done within ~1.5 s of exit; pre-turn and launch-window MCP helpers do not hold; ephemeral <300 ms children do not flap (tests)
No /proc walk while the screen already matches Working, Blocked or confirmed Idle (test)
ping advertises agy_background_work; guarded prompt returns not_ready while held and when the footer shows N task(s); manifest_check defaults to false (tests)
Full fork test pass, api_ping, live_handoff and release build green

tickets.title: HUD trusts the fork's agy status and deletes its turn-child /proc workaround
tickets.live_try: a live agy worker whose brief runs a background `sleep 6` then hud_report: herdr shows working through the wait, HUD does not close early, and closes cleanly within ~2 s of turn end
tickets.what: Second half of the agy native-status fix (oracle job jb786b61850a1b98a, sections Q4 and Slice 2, file:line at MyHUD b184f001). Starts only after herdr-fork/21 is installed (main installs the fork). Require `capabilities.agy_background_work === true` in HUD's herdr capability check / doctor preflight like hidden_tabs and guarded_prompt (explicit fork-upgrade message; no /proc fallback kept, per spec §1: HUD stops inferring what the fork provides). Set packages/hud-mcp/harnesses.json agy.state_trust to "turn". Delete workerHasChild, bootstrap, firstInput / first_sent_at, readBootTimeMs, sampleChild, Facts.liveChild, action 'sample', backgroundChildAlive / background_child_alive in the quiet-decision payload, and the dead startupQuirk 'done-before-prompt', with their tests. Under closeAtReport && declared, close on herdr done/idle as now, or 10 s after declaredAt with an unchanged report signature and no open hud_ask, so a worker that leaves a daemon child running still closes promptly and worker-tree reaping cleans the daemon. Keep: worker-tree.ts and reapDirect close-time reaping, readProcChildren (daemon-binding uses it), the agy .agy-pending mailbox and PreInvocation hook, done receipts and the hud-progress --done fallback, tab-shell/tab-owner for bro and split pi helpers. Also drop the redundant second paneInfo spawn in notifyAgy now that guarded prompt checks state atomically, and simplify readProcChildren's unused options. Update docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/reference.md. Behaviour note to keep in the report: claude/codex/grok workers rely on herdr's own detection plus done.json; an undeclared background child no longer holds a turn open (close still reaps it). Removes: no user-visible feature (internal workaround only).

acceptance.text: HUD refuses worker preflight with a fork-upgrade message when agy_background_work is absent (test)
agy state_trust is turn; the listed workaround code and tests are gone; kept pieces intact
closeAtReport closes on done/idle or 10 s after a declared report with no open question, reaping a lingering daemon (test)
Touched suites pass via tmp/env.sh; docs updated

tickets.title: Fork: the collapsed sidebar draws the HUD role icon too
tickets.live_try: after install, collapse the herdr sidebar with workers running: each worker row shows its role icon in the state colour
tickets.what: Owner live try of herdr-fork/20 (2026-11-26): the expanded sidebar shows HUD role icons, the collapsed sidebar still shows only state dots. `render_collapsed_sidebar` (src/client/shell/sidebar.rs:47, agent rows ~:163) calls `status_icon(agent.agent_status, ...)` and never reads the agent's `hud_icon` metadata token. Use the same token helper the expanded row uses (src/ui/sidebar/tokens.rs HUD_ICON_TOKEN, first grapheme, width 1, fallback to the dot) with exactly the state style the dot would have. Workspace rows in the collapsed sidebar keep their dot. Test beside the existing hud_icon tests (each state style, fallback). Fork worktree on its own branch from `hud`; do not merge, push or install. Document in HUD-FORK.md.

acceptance.text: Collapsed sidebar agent rows draw the hud_icon glyph in the state colour; panes without the token keep the dot (tests)
Workspace rows unchanged; layout widths unchanged (tests)
Isolated fork tests for the touched module, clippy, fmt, release build pass

tickets.title: Fork: select-send gets the just-copied text end to end (owner live failure of 16)
tickets.live_try: after install, drag-select a line in a worker pane with the mouse, press Ctrl+b a within 30 s: the HUD composer opens with that text
tickets.what: Owner live try of herdr-fork/16 on the installed 0.9.5-hud.00caf385 (client and server both new, 2026-11-26): drag-select text with the mouse (copy_on_select default true), then `prefix+a` (keys.command plugin_action hud.select-send.send, plugin manifest contexts=["selection"], MyHUD integrations/herdr/plugin) shows HUD's 'No selection to send' toast: the plugin's HERDR_PLUGIN_CONTEXT_JSON had neither selected_text nor selection. Each half has unit tests (server: src/app/custom_commands.rs plugin_command_delivers_copied_text_after_pane_content_changes; client: recent_copied_selection in src/client/shell/actions.rs:263-318, 690-740, mouse.rs:1755-1775), but nothing tests the chain. Reproduce end to end in the fork's client/headless test harness: drag-select in a pane, mouse up (copy request + response), then the prefix key, then the plugin_action key, through command.invoke to the plugin process env. Cover at least: selecting in the focused pane; selecting in a pane that was not focused before the drag (does mouse down focus it, or does `recent.pane_id != focused_pane_id` drop the text?); the prefix keypress and its timeout between copy and action; a pane whose content changes between copy and action; whether the plugin's `contexts = ["selection"]` gate refuses or strips copied text when there is no live selection. Find where the text is lost, fix it at that point (keep: copy behaviour, highlight timing, 30 s window, clear-on-next-click), and keep the end-to-end test. If the cause is outside herdr (e.g. the host terminal handles the drag and herdr never sees it), say so with the evidence instead of changing code. Document in HUD-FORK.md. Fork worktree on its own branch from `hud`; do not merge, push or install.

acceptance.text: An end-to-end test drives drag-select, mouse up, prefix+a and asserts the plugin receives selected_text equal to the copied text (focused and previously unfocused pane)
The cause is named with file:line; the fix keeps copy behaviour, the 30 s window and clear-on-next-click
fmt, clippy, isolated client/headless tests, release build pass

tickets.title: fork: the drawn cursor stays visible on a cell the app already shows in reverse video
tickets.live_try: After install, the input prompt cursor is visible in a Claude Code pane inside herdr (focused and unfocused panes).
tickets.what: Owner symptom (2026-11-26): no visible cursor in Claude Code panes inside herdr. Facts: `herdr pane read <pane> --format ansi` of a Claude Code pane shows the prompt `❯ ` followed by a reverse-video blank cell (`ESC[7m ESC[0m`), i.e. Claude Code draws its own block cursor. Herdr draws the terminal cursor by XOR-ing REVERSED on the cursor cell (`src/protocol/render_ansi.rs` ~205-222 and `frame_with_drawn_cursor` ~259-268). Hypothesis: Claude Code also leaves the real cursor visible on that same cell (for IME placement), so the two reversals cancel and nothing shows. This code is upstream herdr, not a fork change. Do: (1) confirm or refute the hypothesis with a test that feeds the terminal model a reverse-video cell and a visible cursor on it and checks the drawn frame/patch (both full frame and incremental patch paths, cursor moving onto and off the cell); also find where herdr chooses a drawn cursor versus the host terminal's real cursor and say which path the Claude pane uses. (2) Fix so a visible cursor on an already reversed cell is still visible (e.g. set rather than toggle REVERSED there, or another visible mark), without changing cursor drawing on normal cells and without leaving reversed residue when the cursor moves away. If the hypothesis is wrong, report the real cause with evidence before changing code. Record the behaviour in HUD-FORK.md.

acceptance.text: A test reproduces the invisible cursor on a reverse-video cell before the fix
The cursor on a reversed cell is visible in both full-frame and patch rendering; moving off restores the app's own cell exactly
Cursor drawing on ordinary cells is unchanged (existing tests pass)
HUD-FORK.md records the change
